title: Water Advisory — End of Exercise

fields.resolution: ENDEX. The advisory remains in effect. The city has not provided a date to lift it, and the timeline extends past Sunday evening. The Central Plant tank holds 34,000 gallons, and no resumption date for outpatient dialysis has been set. Two water tankers from Maumee Valley Water Hauling have not yet arrived. All staff, patients, and media continue to hear the same message: no tap water, no drinking, no resumption.
finalState: The city has not lifted the Do Not Drink advisory.
The Central Plant potable water tank holds 34,000 gallons.
No date has been set to resume dialysis.
The two scheduled water tankers have not arrived.
fields.hotWashTransition: Thank you, everyone. Please place your phones and radios down. We will now begin the hot wash.
fields.hotWashMethod: 3-Up, 3-Down: three things that went well, three things that broke
hotWashQuestions: How did the team handle the extended duration of the advisory?
What were the most critical decisions made during the water conservation phase?
How effective was the communication to staff, patients, and the public?
What would have changed if the advisory had been lifted earlier?
How did the team manage uncertainty about the advisory duration?
fields.facilitatorNote: Collect all ICS 201 forms, evaluator sheets, and injected documents before the break. Ensure the AOR is ready to lead the hot wash.

instructorNote: This inject ends the exercise. All roles must now transition to the hot wash. The city’s final confirmation (I-15) and the unfulfilled tanker delivery (I-16) are the final anchors. Do not reveal any hidden threat or future state.
